info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Security Advisory API
info.description: The Enterprise Security Advisory API provides essential insights and recommendations for enhancing security measures within banking enterprises. By utilizing this API, organizations can access tailored security advisories based on specific parameters, helping to identify potential vulnerabilities and compliance requirements. Typical consumers include security analysts, compliance officers, and IT security teams looking to bolster their organizational security posture. This API serves as a critical resource in promoting proactive security management and informed decision-making.

get.description: Fetch details of the security advisory identified by RES-100045, providing insights into the issues addressed and recommended actions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the security advisory identified by RES-100045. It specifies the necessary criteria to fetch the relevant data.

200.description: Request completed successfully and resource returned.

GetEnterpriseServicesSecurityAdvisoryRes.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to security advisories.
